blocks.en: Let $u$ be a solution of $\Delta u=u^3-u$ on a bounded domain $\Omega$. Assume that $u=0$ on $\partial\Omega$. Show that $u\in[-1,1]$ throughout $\Omega$. Can the values $\pm1$ be achieved?
blocks.zh: 设 $u$ 为有界区域 $\Omega$ 上 $\Delta u=u^3-u$ 的一个解. 假设在 $\partial\Omega$ 上 $u=0$. 证明整个 $\Omega$ 内都有 $u\in[-1,1]$. 能否达到值 $\pm1$?
blocks.label: ex:semilinear-cubic-maximum-bound

blocks.en: Assume that the $n\times n$ matrices $\bm{A}$ and $\bm{B}$ are symmetric and positive semidefinite. Show that $\operatorname{tr}(\bm{A}\bm{B})\geq0$. Hint: $\bm{B}=\sum_k\lambda_k\bm{q}_k\bm{q}_k^T$, where the $\lambda_k$ and $\bm{q}_k$ are the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of $\bm{B}$.
blocks.zh: 假设 $n\times n$ 矩阵 $\bm{A}$ 和 $\bm{B}$ 对称且半正定. 证明 $\operatorname{tr}(\bm{A}\bm{B})\geq0$. Hint: $\bm{B}=\sum_k\lambda_k\bm{q}_k\bm{q}_k^T$, 其中 $\lambda_k$ 和 $\bm{q}_k$ 为 $\bm{B}$ 的特征值与特征向量.
